Job Posting Title:
Platform Engineer (Project Hire) 
 Req ID:
10157372 
 Job Description:
 The Platform Engineer is a skilled, independent contributor who designs, implements, and supports core platform and infrastructure capabilities that power magical Disney Experiences across parks, resorts, cruises, and consumer products. You will focus on data pipelines, on-prem server architecture, observability, and DevOps automation, ensuring robust, scalable, and reliable environments that enable teams to deliver seamless guest and cast experiences.
 
 We are seeking an individual to take full ownership of a large-scale Splunk environment supporting mission-critical operational and engineering systems. This role will be responsible for managing the entire Splunk ecosystem from the infrastructure layer (bare metal) through application-level development, in direct support of software engineering teams responsible for complex physical systems and real-time operations.
 
This is a hands-on role requiring deep technical expertise across infrastructure, data ingestion, and observability, with a strong emphasis on reliability, scalability, and performance.
 
 Responsibilities 
 In this role, you will act as a proficient problem-solver and effective partner to engineering and product teams, owning platform components from design through operations while mentoring colleagues and working with minimal guidance. You will emphasize automation, observability, and lifecycle management platforms to improve reliability, reduce operational toil, and support data-driven decisions that enhance Disney Experiences worldwide.
 Own and manage the full Splunk stack

 End-to-end responsibility from bare metal infrastructure → OS → Splunk architecture → dashboards and analytics

 Design, deploy, and maintain Splunk infrastructure

 Install, configure, and optimize Splunk components (indexers, search heads, forwarders, clustering)

 Manage both on-premise/physical server environments and hybrid integrations

 Support real-time operational systems

 Enable monitoring and observability for high-availability, real-time engineering systems

 Build dashboards and alerts used by engineering and operations teams

 Develop data pipelines and ingestion strategies

 Integrate data from diverse sources (logs, sensors, applications, control systems)

 Optimize parsing, indexing, and search performance

 Partner with software engineering leadership

 Work closely with Software Engineering Managers and system teams

 Translate operational requirements into scalable Splunk solutions

 Performance tuning and system reliability

 Identify bottlenecks across infrastructure and data pipelines

 Ensure high availability, redundancy, and system resilience

 Security, governance, and access control

 Implement role-based access and data governance best practices

 Maintain compliance with enterprise security standards

 Continuous improvement

 Recommend architecture improvements and modernization strategies

 Evaluate tools within the Splunk ecosystem (e.g., ITSI, ES, Cribl, etc.)

 
 Required Qualifications 
 3+ years of experience with Splunk administration and development

 Proven experience owning a Splunk environment end-to-end

 Strong hands-on experience with:

 Splunk Enterprise architecture (indexers, search heads, clustering)

 Data ingestion, parsing, and optimization

 Dashboard and alert development

 Experience managing on-prem / bare-metal infrastructure

 Linux administration (preferred)

 Server provisioning, performance tuning, and system monitoring

 Experience supporting real-time, high-availability systems

 Strong scripting skills (Python, Bash, or similar)

 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience supporting engineering, industrial, or operational technology (OT) environments

 Familiarity with observability and logging tools beyond Splunk (e.g., Cribl, ELK, Prometheus)

 Experience with event-driven systems, telemetry data, or IoT/sensor integrations

 Exposure to high-throughput environments with large-scale data ingestion

 Splunk certifications (Admin, Architect, or Developer)

 
 Required Education 
 Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field or relevant work experience

 
The hiring range for this position in Orlando, FL is $92,900 to $124,500 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.
